description:
Raised with a strict upbringing as the son of a pastor, Kim Petros has always lived his life by the book - the Holy Book that is! Resolving to set off on his own path in search of independence, he makes the decision to pursue priesthood. But as the long years he spends in priestly training drag on, and he finds himself in need of a hobby to help pass the time, he decides to step outside his comfort zone and buy a secondhand gaming console. Petros is soon to find, however, that he’s getting much more than he bargained for when the seller, a spirited young woman and his polar opposite, mistakenly brings an adult toy. Could this mysterious woman have just the cure for his boredom, or will she prove to be his ruin instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.*
